Package io.github.janglada.orkit.packing

package io.github.janglada.orkit.packing
Container loading / 3D bin packing solver.

Provides a fluent DSL for packing boxes (each with a length, width, height, and weight) into containers (each with dimensions and a maximum weight capacity), while respecting 3D non-overlap placement and per-container weight limits.

Boxes may optionally opt into orientation and stacking sub-features:

  • Rotation — BoxConfig.rotatable(true) lets the solver reorient the box to any distinct axis-permutation of its dimensions (up to six; a cube has one). The chosen Orientation is reported on each ContainerAssignment.BoxPlacement.
  • Support — PackingBuilder.requireSupport(true) makes every box stand on the floor or rest flush on one box whose XY footprint contains its own (no floating boxes).
  • Stacking precedence — BoxConfig.above(id) / below(id) declare an explicit vertical order between two boxes.
  • Weight-bearing — BoxConfig.maxStackedWeight(w) caps the total weight of boxes stacked on a supporting box.
All sub-features default off, so a model with no opt-ins is the classical fixed-orientation, floating, no-overlap packing.

Each box has one position shared by all containers and one set of separation literals per pair of boxes, strengthened by volume and cross-section relaxations and by symmetry breaking between identical containers and identical boxes, so instances of a few dozen rotatable boxes solve to proven optimality in seconds.

Entry point: Optimize.packing().
